settings.general.global_ai.label: Global AI Features Enabled
settings.general.global_ai.desc: Master toggle for all AI features. When disabled, all AI systems are disabled regardless of their individual settings.
settings.general.notifications.label: Show In-Game Notifications
settings.general.notifications.desc: Show in-game notifications for various operations (e.g., diary entries, dynamic bio updates, trigger execution)
settings.general.auto_docs.label: Auto Generate Documentation
settings.general.auto_docs.desc: Automatically generate documentation for decorators and systems
settings.general.auto_update_base.label: Auto-Update Base Content
settings.general.auto_update_base.desc: Download and apply SkyrimNet's own content fixes (prompts, triggers and actions) between releases. Applied at startup only, never mid-game, and you can always go back to the content that shipped with your installed version.
settings.audio.use_engine_audio.label: Use Skyrim Audio Engine
settings.audio.use_engine_audio.desc: Play speech and bard songs through the Skyrim audio engine instead of a separate device. Speech, bard songs and virtual entities each get their own slider in Skyrim's Audio settings.
settings.audio.pauses_with_game.label: Pause Audio with Game
settings.audio.pauses_with_game.desc: Pause NPC speech and bard songs while the game is paused, like vanilla dialogue. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is enabled.
settings.voice.requires_engine_audio: Requires Use Skyrim Audio Engine to be enabled under Audio settings.
settings.audio.requires_engine_audio: Requires Use Skyrim Audio Engine, above, to be enabled.
settings.audio.player_voice_at_camera.de: Force player voice to always originate from the camera. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is enabled.
settings.audio.tts_target_rms.label: Speech Loudness Target
settings.audio.tts_max_gain.label: Speech Loudness Limit
settings.audio.tts_target_rms.desc: How loud generated speech is made before it reaches the game, matched against vanilla voice lines. Raise it if SkyrimNet dialogue sounds quieter than the game's own, lower it if it sounds louder. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is enabled.
settings.audio.tts_max_gain.desc: Ceiling on how much a quiet voice line may be boosted to reach the loudness target. Higher values rescue very quiet output but can distort it. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is enabled.
settings.audio.listener_output_model.des: Which output model is used for voices that originate from the camera, such as the player or virtual entities. Each carries a different amount of reverb and can be affected by installed mods. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is enabled.
settings.audio.listener_volume.label: Close Voice Volume
settings.audio.listener_volume.desc: How loud voices that originate from the camera are next to ordinary NPC speech. They never lose volume to distance and may sound different. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is enabled.
settings.audio.disabled_by_engine_audio: Skyrim's audio engine handles spatial audio natively when Use Skyrim Audio Engine is enabled.
settings.audio.universal_max_volume.desc: Maximum volume level for all audio playback, both spatial and non-spatial (0.0 to 1.0).
Only affects UI sound effects while Skyrim's audio engine is enabled — speech, bard songs and virtual speakers each follow their own slider in Skyrim's Audio settings.
settings.audio.should_silence_actors.des: Enable or disable automatic actor voice silencing during AI-generated speech
settings.audio.queue_near_completion.des: When audio queue size is at or below this value, audio is considered 'nearing completion'. This triggers early speaker evaluation and conversation lull detection. Default is 2 (trigger when 0, 1, or 2 items remain).
settings.audio.max_audible_distance.desc: Maximum distance before speech audio becomes inaudible (in game units). Controls spatial audio falloff for NPC voices.
settings.audio.spatial_enabled.label: Spatial Audio Enabled
settings.audio.spatial_enabled.desc: Use SkyrimNet's own 3D positioning for speech. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is disabled.
settings.audio.spatial_max_distance.desc: Maximum distance for spatial audio effects; beyond this, audio is inaudible. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is disabled.
settings.audio.spatial_min_distance.desc: Minimum distance for spatial audio effects; closer sources play at max volume. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is disabled.
settings.audio.spatial_rolloff.label: Spatial Audio Rolloff Factor
settings.audio.spatial_rolloff.desc: How quickly volume decreases with distance; higher means faster falloff. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is disabled.
settings.audio.spatial_max_volume.label: Spatial Audio Max Volume
settings.audio.spatial_max_volume.desc: Maximum volume level for spatial audio. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is disabled.
settings.audio.spatial_min_volume.label: Spatial Audio Min Volume
settings.audio.spatial_min_volume.desc: Minimum volume level for spatial audio. Only applies while Skyrim's audio engine is disabled.
settings.audio.input_sfx.label: Enable Input Sound Effects
settings.audio.input_sfx.desc: Play sound effects when starting and ending input
settings.audio.no_transcription_sfx.desc: Play sound effect when no transcription is detected
settings.audio.player_thought_effect.des: Apply special audio effects to player thoughts for distinction
settings.audio.narrator_effect.label: Enable Narrator Audio Effect
settings.audio.narrator_effect.desc: Apply special audio effects to narrator speech for distinction
settings.voice.voice_player_input.label: Voice Player Input
settings.voice.voice_player_input.desc: Generate and play TTS audio for the player's dialogue. When disabled, player input is still processed but the player character remains silent (subtitles only)
settings.voice.player_voice_id.label: Player Voice ID
settings.voice.player_voice_id.desc: Voice ID to use for player character speech synthesis
Voice ID used when the player's inner monologue is spoken aloud (the "Player Thoughts" virtual speaker).
settings.voice.enable_voice_over.label: Enable Voice Over
settings.voice.enable_voice_over.desc: Use TTS for player-selected dialogue. Requires DBVO to be installed and its DBVO.esp disabled or deleted.
settings.voice.silent_tts.label: Enable TTS For Silent NPCs
settings.voice.silent_tts.desc: Generate TTS for silent NPCs (modded dialogue that has no voice acting). Requires DBVO to be installed and its DBVO.esp disabled or deleted.
settings.voice.npc_node_updates.label: Enable NPC Node Updates
settings.voice.npc_node_updates.desc: Improves lip sync for Silent TTS and clears stuck faces in some situations. May cause skin textures to flicker with mods that inject textures at runtime.
settings.voice.narration_enabled.label: Enable Narration
settings.voice.narration_enabled.desc: Enable AI-generated narration for immersive storytelling
Show narration as subtitles without voicing it. Narration still appears in the prompt and the event history.
settings.voice.narration_combat.label: Disable Narration During Combat
settings.voice.narration_combat.desc: Automatically disable narration when the player is in combat
settings.voice.narration_factions.label: Disable Narration Factions
settings.voice.narration_factions.desc: Comma-separated list of faction editor IDs. Narration will be disabled when the player is a member of any of these factions.
settings.voice.abbr_language.label: Abbreviation Language
settings.voice.abbr_language.desc: Which table of abbreviations the sentence splitter uses, so a period after a title such as "Mr." or "г." does not end the spoken segment. Auto follows the active TTS engine's language setting (English for engines without one).
settings.voice.abbr_initials.label: Single-Letter Initials
settings.voice.abbr_initials.desc: Treat a period after one uppercase letter as an initial ("J. R. R. Tolkien") rather than a sentence end. One-letter words such as "I" are exempt per language.
settings.voice.abbr_custom.label: Custom Abbreviations
settings.voice.abbr_custom.desc: Your own abbreviations, applied in every language. One per line, without the trailing period; matching is case-insensitive.
settings.voice.abbr_custom.placeholder: One abbreviation per line, e.g. Cmdr
settings.voice.abbr_table.label: Abbreviations For The Selected Language
settings.voice.abbr_table.desc: The table for the selected language, one entry per line. Edit it here or in config/Abbreviations.yaml; remove an entry if it merges sentences you want split.
settings.voice.use_kokoro.label: Use Kokoro For Narrator
settings.voice.use_kokoro.desc: Enable Kokoro for a much better narrator voice than piper. Only changes the narrator's voice.
settings.voice.kokoro_voice.label: Kokoro Narrator Voice
settings.voice.kokoro_voice.desc: Override narrator voice with this Kokoro voice. 'af_bella' sounds more dramatic, while 'af_heart' is more friendly and natural
settings.voice.kokoro_volume.label: Kokoro Volume Level
settings.voice.kokoro_model.label: Kokoro Model
settings.general.npc_subtitles.label: Enable NPC Subtitles
settings.general.player_subtitles.label: Enable Player Subtitles
settings.general.player_subtitles.desc: Show subtitles when the player is speaking
settings.general.console_output.label: Enable Console Output
settings.general.console_output.desc: Mirror dialogue and narration text to the Skyrim console (~). Useful for testing, VR, or when subtitles don't display.
settings.general.telemetry.label: Send Anonymous Usage Data
settings.general.telemetry.desc: Sends one anonymous ping when the game starts: your SkyrimNet version, your Skyrim version and edition, and coarse hardware details (OS build, CPU model, core count, and rounded RAM and GPU). Hardware details are sent at most once a day. No identifier of any kind is generated or sent — no account, no machine ID — and no dialogue, prompts, saves, file paths or hostnames are ever included. The reply tells SkyrimNet whether a newer version is available. Turning this off sends one final opt-out signal and then stops all contact, including the update check. Every field that can be sent is listed at https://fateless.ai/privacy/telemetry.
settings.general.metrics_telemetry.label: Send Anonymous Usage Metrics
settings.general.metrics_telemetry.desc: Opt-in: sends anonymous usage metrics up to four times per minute while playing — which AI models are in use, how fast providers respond, token and cost totals, and counts of TTS/STT use and player inputs. Never your words, your voice, prompts, or anything that identifies you; idle minutes send nothing at all. Requires 'Send Anonymous Usage Data' to also be on. Off by default until you explicitly enable it. Every field that can be sent is listed at https://fateless.ai/privacy/telemetry.
settings.hotkeys.conflict.message: "{{key}}" is already bound to "{{binding}}". Bind it anyway?
settings.hotkeys.wheel_menu.label: Wheel Menu
settings.hotkeys.wheel_menu.desc: Open the wheel menu with all available options. This provides quick access to all SkyrimNet functions. (default: F12)
settings.hotkeys.toggle_dashboard.label: Open Dashboard
settings.hotkeys.toggle_dashboard.desc: Open or close the SkyrimNet dashboard overlay in-game. (default: F6)
settings.hotkeys.text_input.label: Text Input
settings.hotkeys.text_input.desc: Speak to another NPC via text input. This is the basic way to speak to other characters in the game via text. (default: F1)
settings.hotkeys.record_speech.label: Voice Input (Push to Talk)
settings.hotkeys.record_speech.desc: Push to talk for voice input. Hold to record, release to send. This is the basic way to speak to other characters in the game via voice. (default: F4)
settings.hotkeys.toggle_open_mic.label: Toggle Open Mic
settings.hotkeys.toggle_open_mic.desc: Toggle Open Mic mode for voice input. This an alternative to the push-to-talk Record Speech key.
settings.hotkeys.voice_thought.label: Voice Thought (Push to Talk)
settings.hotkeys.voice_thought.desc: Push to talk for thinking to yourself via voice. Hold to record, release to send. Quick tap sends an empty prompt to trigger a thought. (default: V key)
settings.hotkeys.voice_transform.label: Voice Dialogue Transform (Push to Talk)
settings.hotkeys.voice_transform.desc: Push to talk for transforming your dialogue into character-appropriate roleplay via voice. Hold to record, release to send. Quick tap sends an empty prompt to trigger dialogue. (default: F7)
settings.hotkeys.voice_direct.label: Voice Direct Input (Push to Talk)
settings.hotkeys.voice_direct.desc: Push to talk for the GameMaster's direct input mode via voice. Hold to record, release to send. This will allow you to specify any given thing as fact, and have the LLM act upon it. For example, if you were to say 'Lightning suddenly strikes', characters in game would react as if it had happened. (default: O key)
settings.hotkeys.dialogue_choice.label: Dialogue Choice (Push to Talk)
settings.hotkeys.dialogue_choice.desc: LLM-assisted vanilla dialogue option selection, active only while the Dialogue Menu is open. Quick tap: the LLM picks an option from event history and highlights it (you confirm with Enter). Hold and speak: voice your intent and the LLM matches it to an available option. Its reasoning is logged as an event NPCs can later reference. (default: unset)
settings.hotkeys.continue_narration.desc: Prompt another NPC to speak autonomously. This is useful if you want to have an NPC react to something that has occurred, or to continue a conversation that has stopped. (default: F8)
settings.hotkeys.toggle_continuous.label: Toggle Continuous Mode
settings.hotkeys.toggle_continuous.desc: Toggle continuous scene mode. When enabled, NPCs will keep the conversation going - the GameMaster triggers a new speaker as soon as the previous one finishes talking. Works like a D&D session where the DM keeps the scene moving. (default: F10)
settings.hotkeys.toggle_whisper.label: Toggle Whisper Mode
settings.hotkeys.toggle_whisper.desc: Toggle whisper interaction distance on/off. When on, sets interaction.maxDistance to interaction.whisperMaxDistance; when off, restores interaction.normalMaxDistance. (default: unset)
settings.hotkeys.toggle_gm.label: Toggle GameMaster
settings.hotkeys.toggle_gm.desc: Toggle the autonomous GameMaster functionality on or off. This feature controls when the GameMaster periodically prompts NPC's to speak. (default: F3)
settings.hotkeys.toggle_global_ai.label: Toggle SkyrimNet
settings.hotkeys.toggle_global_ai.desc: Toggle the master switch for all AI features on or off. When disabled, all AI functionality is disabled. (default: unset)
settings.hotkeys.toggle_world_events.des: Toggle whether NPC's react to events (dialogue, combat, death, quest stages, etc.). When disabled, NPCs will not autonomously react to events (Including other NPC's dialogue). (default: X key)
settings.hotkeys.capture_crosshair.label: Capture Crosshair
settings.hotkeys.capture_crosshair.desc: Multi-purpose capture hotkey. Quick press (< 1s): captures the actor or furniture in your crosshairs. Hold (>= 1s): captures the player character. Use to catalog NPCs, objects, and your player on-demand. While a book is open, captures the book instead and fires a book_read event once you close it (textless pages get an OmniSight screenshot description if enabled), regardless of the Auto Book Reading setting. (default: Numpad 0)
settings.hotkeys.diary_bio.label: Generate Diary & Bio
settings.hotkeys.diary_bio.desc: Generate diary entries and dynamic bio updates for selected actors. Opens a menu to choose: Player Only, Nearby Actors, Pinned Actors, or Target in Crosshair. (default: Not set)
settings.hotkeys.interrupt_dialogue.desc: Immediately interrupt and purge all ongoing NPC dialogue. Stops any currently playing or queued speech, clearing the dialogue queue. Useful when you want to cut off an NPC mid-sentence or clear stuck dialogue. (default: Not set)
settings.hotkeys.open_label_panel.label: Open Labelling Panel
settings.hotkeys.open_label_panel.desc: Pause the game and open the labelling panel over the last recorded outputs. Needs Record Requests on (Developer > Request Recording). (default: Not set)
settings.voice.force_subs_silent.label: Force Subtitles To Match Silent Dialogue TTS
settings.voice.force_subs_silent.desc: Forces subtitles to match the audio for Silent Dialogue TTS. The subtitles will briefly flicker when this happens.
settings.dashboard.language.label: Dashboard Language
settings.dashboard.language.desc: Language used for all dashboard text. More translations will be available as the dashboard is finalized.
settings.dashboard.theme.search_desc: Dashboard color theme: Dragonborn, Terminal, Paper, or custom accent and background colors.
settings.dashboard.ui_scale.label: UI Scale
settings.dashboard.ui_scale.desc: Zoom level for the entire dashboard. Useful for reading the overlay from a distance in VR.
settings.dashboard.fullscreen.label: Fullscreen
settings.dashboard.fullscreen.desc: When enabled, the dashboard will fill the entire screen. The world will not be rendered behind the dashboard, resulting in improved performance.
When you open the dashboard with an NPC in your crosshair, jump straight to that character's bio — or the New Character form if they don't have one yet.
